title: A few words on DS4
summary: Salvatore Sanfilippo (antirez, creator of Redis) writes a brief update about DS4 (Data Structures 4), his experimental data structure research project written in C. The article discusses his thoughts on the project direction and design decisions.
problem_solved: Sharing insights and updates on the experimental DS4 project for community feedback.
why_valuable: DS4 explores novel approaches to data structure design, continuing antirez's tradition of creating practical, well-designed systems software that the developer community highly respects.
